notes.title: Update 0.6! Translations!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In todays update we tick off one more of the roadmaps features! We added translations to the game! Now you can play our game in German, Spanish, Russian, French, Portuguese and English!
The language dropdown is located in the Settings -> Gameplay menu!
Update 0.6 includes the following changes:

- Added translations to the game: German, Spanish, Russian, French, Portuguese and English!

Disclaimer: These are not our main languages and some errors can happen in some translations, we urge you to report it to us if you encounter any spelling errors and we will promptly correct it!

Thank you everyone! Hope you enjoy it!

tags.feature: - Added translations to the game: German, Spanish, Russian, French, Portuguese and English!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2 Changelog!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We just rolled out a short hotfix to fix a major bug that was messing with quest progression in the motel mission.
Hotfix 1.0.2 includes the following changes:

- Fixed a major bug with quest progression in the "Finding your way" mission; (thanks @Renwar0#9230 !)
- Created a loading message so players know when the game is loading;

A short hotfix for today as this week we will be taking a more serious look at loading times on the main scene aswell as options for changing controls. We'll also take a look and adjust values of the camera and damage of the vehicle system.

Hope you have a great week!

tags.bug: - Fixed a major bug with quest progression in the "Finding your way" mission; (thanks @Renwar0#9230 !)

notes.title: Update 0.4 Changelog!

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where blockers were not in place for one of the factorys buildings;
- Corrected the Shaperned Stone crafting recipe description;
- Crafting a gauze should now give you the correct item;
- Crafting an Heavy Bandage should now give you the correct item;
- Level is now displayed correctly when starting the game or loading a last save;
- Closing the sleep menu on a bed or sleeping bag now awakes you automatically;
- UI on the sleeping bag no longer rotates with the object;

tags.balance_change: - Sleep speed rate normalized on beds;

tags.bug: - You should now be able to sleep on all beds in the game;
- Fixed a bug where the player wasnt colliding with the bed;
- Prevented players from going up ladders in the Military Base;
- Removed ability to rotate the trident trap (due to a bug that was happening with the UI);

tags.balance_change: - Adjusted jump values;

tags.bug: - Corrected the Unstuck label;
- The character should now never attack when a UI window is open and you click anywhere on the screen;
- Fixed a bug where the character stopped being able to attack after the player closed an UI window;
- Fixed a bug where you could control a progress bar when doing an action;

tags.feature: - Improved load times;
- Added loot to all cars in the game;

tags.bug: - Fixed Shotgun reloading adding more bullets than it was supposed to;

tags.feature: - Sprinting is now directional, you can sprint facing enemies!
- The character no longer locks in the sprinting animation;
- You are now able to melee attack while sprinting;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where the character would sprint faster or slower if you hovered over an UI element while sprinting;

notes.title: Update 0.3 Changelog!

tags.bug: - Fixed Empty gas can crafting recipe description;
- Fixed Medical kit crafting recipe description;
- Fixed Stone Pickaxe, Hammer crafting recipe descripition;
- Fixed bandits not engaging in combat;
- Inventory huge Stability update;

tags.feature: - Added sound recognition to all AI. All enemies should now aggro when hearing footsteps or bullet noise;
- Zombies will now wander when spawned. They should only aggro when they hear or see the player;
- Added global bullet impact effects;

- Added ability to unstack items by pressing SHIFT + Right Mouse button on a stacked item and dragging it to another slot. You will be prompted to choose how many items you want to unstack and confirm;
- Bandits can now damage the car;
- You can now run over bandits;
- Added metal scraps to all loots;

tags.bug: - Fixed having to use a lockpick on the locked house after you've completed the mission and already unlocked it;
- Fixed a bug where if you picked up the shotgun in the locked house, all the bullets would despawn;
- Fixed dialog with the survivor in the suburbs;

tags.balance_change: - Energy bars and Energy drinks now stack up to 5;
- Increased stack size of cooked meat and fish to 5;

tags.feature: - Added back time scale increase when sleeping;

tags.bug: - Fixed time going faster and faster the more times you clicked on the sleep button;

notes.title: Update 0.2 Changelog!

tags.feature: - Added a pause system, when you pause the game using the Escape key, it now correctly pauses the game;

tags.bug: - Fixed Suburbs survivor dialog not showing up;
- Temporarily removed all autosaves in certain quests that were causing a bug to happen where the player couldnt progress further (This will later be reintroduced);

tags.balance_change: - Reduced the sleeping bag crafting recipe requirements to 2x Cloths;
- Reduced the Empty Gas Can crafting recipe requirements to 2x Plastic Pieces;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where you could use consumables infinitely;

tags.feature: - Added an additional tip to help players save the game;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug where you couldnt reload the shotgun after picking it up in the suburbs;
- Fixed a bug where, after picking up a shotgun from the ground, the quest system would break;
- Fixed the scrollbar in the crafting menu so it better represents how many items are in the crafting list;

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug which caused the hotbar and all of your chest items to disappear;

- Fixed a bug in the "Finding the Motel" mission where, if you quit the game while on that mission, the area block would still be there and you could proceed;

notes.title: Road Map Announcement
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today i'm here to present to you our road map for the upcoming months of Early Access of V1ruz. As we are a small team we cannot really commit to times on these updates so we will present you a full list of features we plan to implement into the game in no particular order. We are committed to this project and want to make this the best game we can! Here is the full list of features (More can be added over time):

[list]
[b][*] Improved AI (Bandits, Zombies, Nightcrawlers)
[*] More Wildlife Options: Deers , Wolves, Boars.
[*] Map rework (biomes and locations)
[*] Graphics Improvements
[*] Graphics Optimizations
[*] More Options added: Graphics, Controls, Sound
[*] Zombie Invasions
[*] Bandit Raids
[*] Implement Community Feedback: Loot Rebalancing + Stats
[*] Bandit Camps
[*] Game Translations (Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, German)
[*] Weather System upgrade
[*] Implement Community Suggestions: More Crafts + Overall Gameplay
[*] Animation Overhaul (Character + Zombies + Bandits)
[*] Sound Upgrade
[*] More zombie mutations
[*] Campaign Continuation
[*] Companion Feature
[*] Survivor Saving + Recruiting
[*] More housing options and crafts
[*] More Weapons
[*] More Objectives
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Cards
[*] More Vehicles[/b]
[/list]

We hope you enjoy our game as much as we do! Thank you for being with us through this journey, we value every suggestion highly and want to make this game with the help of community feedback so if you have any suggestion please feel free to speak to us in our Discord or in the Steam Discussions!

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/DTMvjs2

Sincerely,
Polyverse Games

notes.title: Devlog #01 - New Features!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Today we want to show you some of the features we have been working on for the release of the Early Access!

[h2][b]Dismemberment![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36451493/3efcf89a64e43c1d42de2ff237499e87109eadfa.gif[/img]
[previewyoutube=CFWh_jDUI6g;full][/previewyoutube]

Introducing our brand new [b]Dismemberment System![/b] Now you can visciously kill zombies and send their heads flying everywhere!

[h2][b]The Sniper![/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=fa_KC5OQXOA;full][/previewyoutube]
Now you will be able to see farther and shoot zombies in the head with our brand new sniper!

[h2][b]A Bear![/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=WnwnJabyww4;full][/previewyoutube]
Introducing a new member of our wildlife! A ferocious and vicious bear that will attack you on sight, you have to come prepared as he is very tough to kill, the rewards are big though! 
This will be one of the random encounters we have in the game.

[h2][b]Player progression![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36451493/224c911bf9b5021b6223c762aa1eaa21965afa54.jpg[/img]

Introducing a new progression system in the game! Now you will be able to earn experience from crafting, killing enemies and wildlife, gathering and quests to progress and level your character up. By doing this you will be able to pick and choose where you want your talent points to go and power up!


[h2][b]World Map![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36451493/139cc02379ae0d5fbee71f36b7ed43db6745ace3.gif[/img]

Now you can more clearly see the map and know which zone to go to! 

[h2][b]Crafting![/b][/h2]
[previewyoutube=yAloJVUlRi0;full][/previewyoutube]

You will to craft your own base and build upon it to defend yourself from all the zombies and bandits roaming the world! 
Also, there will be a whole set of crafts introduced into the game with this update, these crafts are:
[list]
[*][b].9mm Bullet Box[/b]
[*][b]Glock-19 Magazine[/b]
[*][b]12-Gauge Shell[/b]
[*][b]45mm Bullet Box[/b]
[*][b]M4 magazine[/b]
[*][b]AK-47 magazine[/b]
[*][b]51mm Bullet Box[/b]
[*][b]51mm Magazine[/b]
[*][b]Weapon Repair Kit[/b]
[*][b]Steel[/b]
[*][b]Steel Axe[/b]
[*][b]Steel Pickaxe[/b]
[*][b]Combat Knife[/b]
[*][b]Machete[/b]
[*][b]Steel Arrow[/b]
[*][b]Steel Hammer[/b]
[*][b]Stone Axe[/b]
[*][b]Stone Pickaxe[/b]
[*][b]Stone Hammer[/b]
[*][b]Fishing Rod[/b]
[*][b]Nails[/b]
[*][b]Reloading Bench[/b]
[*][b]Workbench[/b]
[*][b]Blacksmith[/b]
[*][b]Gause[/b]
[*][b]Heavy Bandage[/b]
[*][b]Wooden Fence[/b]
[*][b]Basic Cabin[/b]
[*][b]Bed[/b]
[*][b]Chest[/b]
[*][b]Log Fence[/b]


[/list]

[h2][b]Fishing![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36451493/ca852e211f8d68b09d4f427ff3625cb4471dd6d5.gif[/img]

Now you will be able to fish! Fishing will play a big part in the game as it will be a good food source throughout the whole game

[h2][b]Gathering![/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36451493/11493d17f021d18dcf299965b13d13c1a32d7731.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36451493/24d42535764b792b42de0de9ef6375e74275690f.gif[/img]

There are new ways of gathering in the game, now you can use an axe and a pickaxe to collect logs from trees and rocks from mining sites respectively

If you like what you see please join our Discord community and Wishlist the game!

Discord link: https://discord.gg/mFJRZ8b

THank you all for reading!
